response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer with 13+ years across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, a CS degree, and clear community leadership through talks, workshops and open-source tooling. However, the resume shows essentially no evidence of the core requirements for this role: experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical/experimental analysis. The scope also reads as senior/staff IC in small-to-mid companies rather than Principal/IC6 leading multi-workstream, cross-org initiatives at enterprise scale, and there is little demonstrated data aptitude or growth-measurement ownership. Worth a screening call only if the team is open to a strong generalist who would ramp into the experimentation domain.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on engineering across many stacks (TS/Node, C/C++, Java, C#, DLang)
Low-latency, high-volume microservices experience at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (millions of req/s)
Strong engineering-culture leadership: TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source test tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flighting platform experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data analysis depth
Scope and influence appear below Principal/IC6 (no multi-team, multi-product initiative ownership)

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope gap vs. Principal IC6 expectations
Deep, broad hands-on engineering and distributed-systems background
